hypothesis: A candidate coding model improves at least one canned benchmark outcome without regressing safety or reliability guardrails.
expectedMechanism: The candidate model should preserve simple instruction following, arithmetic, JSON formatting, and safety refusal behavior while using the same evaluator.
notes: Edit the baseline and candidate model names to match models installed in your local daemon before executing a non-dry run. Keep this canned manifest as a smoke test, not release evidence.
